payload.text: Carry::carry_rate() is a pure accessor over the asset-class-agnostic carry seam (FxRates{r_dom,r_for} | CostOfCarry{r,b}). Every pricing engine consumes the Carry seam rather than raw FX rate fields, and there is no hot-path match on Carry/Underlying. This keeps one asset-class-agnostic pricing contract across vanilla/exotics/surface/risk and the crypto/equity/commodity leaves (ADR-0008).
